def factor_range_expansion_reversal_vol_confirm(df):
    """Range expansion reversal with volume confirmation: oversold bounce only when volume is elevated."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    range_ = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]
    range_mean = range_.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    range_std = range_.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1)
    range_z = (range_ - range_mean) / range_std.replace(0, np.nan)
    ret5 = df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].shift(5) - 1
    raw_signal = -ret5 * range_z
    avg_vol = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    vol_condition = df_copy["volume"] > 1.2 * avg_vol
    signal = raw_signal * np.where(vol_condition, 1.0, 0.5)
    signal = signal.ewm(span=3, min_periods=3).mean()
    df_copy["factor_range_expansion_reversal_vol_confirm"] = signal
    return df_copy["factor_range_expansion_reversal_vol_confirm"]
description: Evolved from range_exp_rev_001, preserving the range expansion reversal logic but incorporating volume conviction filter from alpha-herding-0-2. The signal is only active when volume exceeds 1.2x its 20-day average, indicating strong participation that validates the oversold condition. This reduces noise from low-volume reversals and enhances signal quality. The negative sign inverts the 5-day return to produce positive score for deep drops with wide ranges. Exponential smoothing (span=3) smooths the sparse signal.
